commands.command: OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 PYTHONPATH=src conda run -n autodrift python -m autodrift.hidden_envelope_probe --checkpoint runs/m62_m37_m61_032_interpolated_checkpoints/checkpoints/alpha_0_25.pt --env-config configs/ppo_m24_human_view_gru_driver.json --episodes 30 --seed 9410 --horizon-steps 15 --sample-stride 3 --max-samples 800 --ridge 0.1 --device cpu --run-dir runs/m93_m62_hidden_envelope_probe_seed9410
commands.name: m62_hidden_envelope_probe

decision_rule: Treat M62 hidden state as envelope-belief evidence only if normal response_hidden beats reset_response_hidden on at least braking and yaw future-envelope targets without hurting lateral response.
failure_criteria: normal recurrent hidden is not compared against same-frame reset hidden
future-envelope targets are replaced by hidden physical parameters
normal response_hidden is worse than reset_response_hidden on braking or yaw
results are interpreted as driver promotion instead of diagnostic evidence
hypothesis: M62 may already encode useful no-wheel response history in its recurrent hidden state even though prior behavior gates were weak.
success_criteria: M62 checkpoint hidden state is evaluated on future braking yaw and lateral envelope targets
normal response_hidden is compared with reset_response_hidden on the same samples
decision states whether M62 hidden is already a sufficient envelope belief
